# DIU Foundry

> DIU Foundry is a technology studio engineering custom AI systems, intelligent software, embedded systems, IoT ecosystems, and premium digital products.

DIU Foundry partners with startups, enterprises, and researchers to build intelligent products. Every idea is a spark. Build the flame.

## Services

- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning — custom models, agents, and pipelines
- Modern Web Applications — React, Next.js, TypeScript, TanStack
- Mobile Applications — native and cross-platform
- Embedded Systems & IoT — firmware, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, FreeRTOS
- Cloud Infrastructure — AWS, Vercel, edge infrastructure
- Cybersecurity — threat modelling, hardening, audits
- APIs & Backend — Node.js, Python, Rust, Go, PostgreSQL
- DevOps & Infrastructure — Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions
